assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ab initio molecular dynamics unified electronic-structure theory with finite-temperature dynamics and opened condensed-phase chemistry (water, solvation, reactive processes, materials) to quantitative simulation. It is original, conceptually clean and quantitatively tied to experiment, which is the standard I apply to theory; the consequences are field-wide and long established.
assessment.attribution: The 1985 paper by Car and Parrinello is the unambiguous origin and two names fit a prize cleanly. Parrinello also appears under metadynamics and machine-learned potentials, so a single laureate pair here would implicitly recognise his wider programme.
assessment.maturity: Four decades of independent use, with a very large user base and many derived codes; the interpretation is stable and recognition is, if anything, overdue.
uncertainties: Computational method prizes are sometimes judged to overlap with the 2013 multiscale and 1998 DFT recognition.
I cannot independently verify citation or adoption numbers from memory.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Pd-catalysed C-N coupling made aryl amines routinely accessible and is used daily in pharmaceutical and materials synthesis. It is a simple, general and practical reaction with enormous demonstrated consequences, in the spirit of prizes that reward not overcomplicating matters.
assessment.attribution: Buchwald and Hartwig independently developed the ligand-controlled catalytic systems and are the natural pair. Kosugi (and Migita) did earlier tin-amide work that is a precursor; including him would dilute the decisive ligand-design contribution. Priority questions remain.
assessment.maturity: Mature and universal in industry for about 25 years; the 2010 cross-coupling prize left this reaction unrecognised.
uncertainties: Some committee members may see it as too close to the 2010 cross-coupling prize.
Precise attribution of precursor tin-amide chemistry is not something I can verify from memory.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation is a new pharmacological modality: PROTACs and molecular glues redirect the ubiquitin-proteasome system to remove proteins. It is a genuine game-changer with several compounds in clinical trials and the mechanism of thalidomide-type glues was resolved at molecular level.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and developed the PROTAC concept; Handa identified cereblon as the thalidomide target underlying molecular glues. The credited list is long (Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto, Kim, Ito), so credit among the PROTAC and glue branches is not settled; a trio is a defensible compromise.
assessment.maturity: Strong mechanistic validation and early clinical data, but no approved PROTAC degrader yet to my knowledge, so clinical proof is still maturing.
uncertainties: Whether PROTAC and glue-degrader branches should share one prize or be treated separately.
Clinical approval status is uncertain to me.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editing converts one base to another without double-strand breaks, a conceptually new chemical approach to genome editing built on engineered deaminases. It has already produced clinical-stage therapies and transformed research use.
assessment.attribution: Liu's group designed and demonstrated the first cytosine and adenine base editors, with Komor and Gaudelli as lead authors. A prize based on this candidate alone would plausibly go to Liu alone; Nishida and Kondo made a parallel cytidine-deaminase editor, which complicates priority.
assessment.maturity: Fast uptake and early clinical results; independent confirmation is extensive, but the field is young and long-term safety is open.
uncertainties: Genome editing may be judged closer to medicine than chemistry, and CRISPR was recognised in 2020.
Treatment of the Nishida/Kondo parallel work is unresolved.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles made systemic nucleic-acid delivery practical and underpin siRNA drugs and mRNA vaccines, giving unmistakable real-world consequences. The chemistry of pH-dependent ionizable lipids and rational formulation is the decisive enabling step.
assessment.attribution: Cullis's group in Vancouver developed the key lipid-particle formulation principles; Hope, Madden and MacLachlan are central coauthors, with Anderson and Langer on later lipid libraries. Attribution is genuinely contested and a prize needs a three-person choice that I find hard to defend firmly.
assessment.maturity: Validated at global scale by approved siRNA drugs and COVID vaccines; recognition is timely, though the 2023 Medicine prize touched adjacent mRNA science.
uncertainties: Overlap with the 2023 Medicine prize for mRNA vaccines.
Which lipid-chemistry contributions are decisive is uncertain to me.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Structure and mechanism of nitrogenase address how nature reduces N2 to ammonia at the FeMo cofactor, a fundamental enzymology question with strong links to the Haber-Bosch process and energy. Structures plus spectroscopic and kinetic work are connecting to mechanism, which I value.
assessment.attribution: Rees led the first and subsequent structural work, Einsle resolved the central interstitial carbide, and Seefeldt contributes kinetic and mechanistic frameworks. Dean and Ribbe are also credited, so the three-person selection is debatable.
assessment.maturity: Structures are well confirmed but the catalytic mechanism is still debated, so the complete picture is not yet settled.
uncertainties: The reaction mechanism of N2 reduction is not fully resolved.
The balance between structural and mechanistic contributors is unclear.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Machine-learned interatomic potentials bring near-quantum accuracy to large-scale molecular dynamics and are changing how materials and molecules are simulated. The consequences are already large, though the field is moving quickly.
assessment.attribution: Behler and Parrinello's neural-network potentials started the approach, and Csányi's Gaussian approximation potentials are an independent line. Bartók, von Lilienfeld and E are also credited; with more than three plausible originators, a fair configuration is hard.
assessment.maturity: Rapid adoption but still evolving with foundation models; generality, extrapolation reliability and the eventual stable framework are not yet clear, so it may be premature.
uncertainties: Recognition may be premature given fast-changing methods.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The funnel energy-landscape view of protein folding resolved Levinthal's paradox and gave a quantitative framework linked to experiment (folding kinetics, phi-value analysis). It is conceptually profound and underlies physics-based thinking about biomolecules.
assessment.attribution: Wolynes and Onuchic with Bryngelson developed the funnel theory; Dill contributed the hydrophobic-collapse and lattice-model picture; Fersht supplied the experimental mapping. Fair credit across theory and experiment is hard in three slots.
assessment.maturity: Long-established concepts, but practical impact has partly been overtaken by the 2024 structure prediction prize, which may reduce urgency.
uncertainties: 2024 Chemistry prize on protein design and structure prediction partly overlaps.
Division between theory and experimental contributors is unresolved.
